reviews.title: Review ✈️
reviews.text: Decent app , after all you can see and track the planes but it is soo laggy, I tried to look at a few flights but it took me ages . And the ads come on I’m not paying 10 or 3 and I had 2 days left of my free triel but it said 5.49 pounds , i was still on my free triel 🤬. I have had this app for a long time such as flight radar 24 and planes live is not even close to flight radar 24 . Lastly the updates I had a flight which got delayed 7 hours but guess what 6 and a half hour later it said the plane was on time …

reviews.title: Missing flight data everywhere what’s up?
reviews.text: I sent something in with no response. Checking today for flights from Fort Lauderdale to Boston again and it shows there aren’t any next week or after. I’m about ready to cancel what’s going on with your data? When it’s working, it’s a five star app. If it doesn’t have the flights it’s not even a one star app Thanks.

reviews.title: Adult Ads Showing
reviews.text: Just installed and glad no kids were around as very graphic adult ads showing right at the top. I’m sure this is from a third party ad network but I’d be selecting one that was far more restrictive before dropping it on my application.  I’m certain the application is built well based on the reviews but this is not acceptable.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: Downloaded this app with the sole purpose of tracking a relatives flight and receiving a notification when the flight landed. It don’t allow me to track the flight, just showed me all the flights in the air, and it didn’t notify me when the flight landed. Not really sure what the point of the app is to be honest as it didn’t update to say the flight had departed or anything other than the scheduled times.
